features.statement: Page uses a warm off-white body background with dark slate body text.
A single saturated orange accent marks key elements: header rule, active dot, phone number, highlighted heading words and utility link.
Muted pale blue-gray text is used for secondary or footer copy on dark backgrounds.
Page stacks full-width color bands: white header, navy hero, off-white content, mid-blue contact band, dark navy legal footer.
Content sits in a narrow centered column with wide empty side margins on desktop.
Layout relies on little grid or flex, with simple stacked block flow.
Header has a left logo, a centered row of small brand logos, and a right-aligned phone number with caption.
Footer contact area is split into two columns, with hours on the left and address on the right.
Heading hierarchy is weak: no h1, with only one h2 and one h3.
Semantic landmarks are minimal: header, main, sections and footer, with no nav, article, aside or figure.
Class usage is small and hand-named, with no utility-class framework patterns.
All images carry alt text and ARIA attributes are present for accessibility.
Headings are split into two colors and weights within a single line.
Body text is 16px with a generous 1.6 line-height.
Most corners are square, with only a few small radii and fully round indicator dots.
Carousel uses small circular dot indicators, filled for the active slide and outlined for the others.
Carousel slides are stacked at the same position, overlapping fully.
No CSS gradients; embossed, shadowed and metallic effects are baked into raster images.
Marketing copy, captions and badge labels are delivered as text embedded in raster images instead of live HTML text.
Multiple logos or badges are combined into single images, often on a white rounded panel.
Hero is a multi-panel photo collage with an in-image caption.
Pipe characters serve as separators in captions, hours lines and the title.
Copy is sparse and plain: few live words and no emoji, em dashes or exclamation marks.
Phone number is repeated as the main call to action, with no form fields or button-styled CTAs.
Footer includes a centered copyright, a credit link and a long run of license numbers.
Page ends with a centered back-to-top link that includes an arrow character.
Brand names are repeated both as logos and inline text, with registered marks.
Line breaks are used for multi-line address and hours blocks.
